notes.title: Community and game release announcement
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the people who are interested in the project do not hesitate to join the discord: [url=https://discord.gg/fDBsbtycSe]Join the discord[/url]

In the meantime, don't hesitate to add the game to your wishlist!
